name: CHUHATSU North America, Inc.
old_description: CHUHATSU North America is proud to be part of Chuo Spring Co., LTD, a trusted global manufacturer of springs and control cables with over 75 years of innovation and excellence. Backed by decades of experience, we share in their enduring commitment to craftsmanship, creativity, and customer satisfaction. Together, we strive to meet the evolving needs of our industry while supporting a better, brighter future for our customers.
about:
CHUHATSU North America, Inc. operates a 300,000-square-foot facility in Glasgow, Kentucky. The company was formed in February 2017 through the merger of ACK (established 1989) and Chuo Precision Spring, becoming the North American arm of Chuo Spring Co., Ltd., a Japanese spring and control cable manufacturer founded in 1948.

The facility produces a range of automotive springs and control cables, including chassis springs, precision coil springs, flat springs, formed wire springs, leaf springs, torsion bars, torsion springs, snap rings, and spiral springs, as well as heavy-duty and light-duty control cables. Additional capabilities include stamping, e-coating, motor mount assembly, and stabilizer bar production. CHUHATSU serves as both a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier to major automobile manufacturers.

Its customer base spans passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and ATVs and UTVs, with products designed for automotive OEM and Tier supplier programs from development through long-term production. The company emphasizes custom spring solutions tailored to specific vehicle platforms.

CHUHATSU’s corporate philosophy centers on enriching society through technology, pioneering the future with human wisdom, and challenging itself to fulfill every dream. Its stated objective is to design and manufacture the highest-quality products at competitive prices, provide superior service, meet delivery commitments, and employ qualified people with training opportunities. The company holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications and has received the President’s Award from its parent company along with multiple customer delivery and performance awards.

name: CM Solutions, Inc.
old_description: CM Solutions is an innovative Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider that focuses on delivering complete end-to-end manufacturing capabilities with the latest technological solutions for companies.
about:
CM Solutions, Inc. was founded in 2002 in Corinth, Mississippi, as a privately owned contract manufacturer serving all electronics market segments. The company was established by Mike, Ron, Jack, and Tommy, who brought decades of combined experience in OEM and contract manufacturing both domestically and abroad. The founders remain actively involved in daily operations, maintaining a hands-on approach with customers.

The firm provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services (EMS), including build-to-order (BTO), configure-to-order (CTO), and direct-ship programs that integrate seamlessly into customer supply chains. Over its history, CM Solutions has expanded its facility three times, growing to five production lines equipped with selective soldering, automatic optical inspection (AOI), multiple in-circuit test platforms, a DEK Horizon SMT printer, a Faraday cage for RF circuitry, and a dedicated conformal coating room. The company supports low-, medium-, and high-volume production with lead-free (RoHS-compliant) processes.

CM Solutions serves a range of industries, including automotive, medical, military, and general OEM markets. Its customer base spans domestic and international clients seeking customized manufacturing solutions for electronic assemblies. The company’s quality system aligns with IPC-A-610 Classes 1–3 and J-STD-001 standards, enabling it to meet the stringent requirements of regulated sectors.

The business was built on a customer-focused philosophy, emphasizing engineering capabilities, dedication to specific end markets, and technology advantages. With over 100 years of combined industry experience among its leadership, CM Solutions positions itself as a high-performance, cost-effective partner that prioritizes continuous improvement and on-time delivery.

name: CMC Steel Alabama
old_description: At CMC, we’re proud of our heritage, but we’re even prouder of the innovative and pioneering spirit that has set us apart from our competitors and taken our mill operations and our products to new heights. Automation and environmentally friendly process advancements have revolutionized the way CMC makes steel.
about:
CMC Steel Alabama operates a steel mill in Birmingham, Alabama, as part of Commercial Metals Company (CMC), which emphasizes its heritage and innovative spirit in steelmaking. The facility uses electric arc furnace technology in a mini-mill configuration, with a melt capacity exceeding 5 million tons of finished long steel products annually. It produces a wide range of products including rebar, merchant bar, wire rod, and specialty engineered steels such as ChromX (corrosion-resistant reinforcing steel), GalvaBar (continuously galvanized rebar), CryoSteel (for cryogenic applications down to −274 °F), and Impact Metals (armor-grade steel). The mill also manufactures fence posts from 100% recycled U.S. billet steel and offers value-added processing like spooled and coiled rebar, structural shapes, and specialty bar items.

The company serves construction, infrastructure, energy, commercial, and industrial markets, supplying service centers, OEMs, joist manufacturers, metal building fabricators, and precast concrete producers. Its specialty products target marine infrastructure, defense and transportation OEMs, heavy equipment manufacturers, and LNG projects requiring cryogenic performance.

CMC differentiates itself through its low-carbon EAF steelmaking process, which it says produces 63% lower emissions intensity than the industry average, supplemented by renewable energy credits and carbon offsets. Proprietary product lines like ChromX and CryoSteel are designed to extend service life in harsh environments, while an integrated logistics network across multiple states supports reliable supply.

name: CRP Automotive
old_description: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA) was founded in 1947 and is the oldest organized group of warehouse distributors and their respective suppliers of parts, accessories and other supplies for the motor vehicle aftermarket. AWDA’s 600+ members represent thousands of locations.
about:
CRP Automotive operates as a business unit of CRP Industries, a veteran-owned family business headquartered in Cranbury, New Jersey. Founded in 1954, the company began as a small importer offering roughly 200 sizes of German-manufactured tires to the North American market. Over more than 70 years of continuous operation, it has grown into an industry leader supplying thousands of automotive replacement parts and fluids across the continent. The privately held company spans three generations of family ownership and maintains additional facilities in South Carolina, Michigan, and Puebla, Mexico.

The company develops, manufactures, and distributes a broad portfolio of aftermarket products under brands that include AAE steering components, Rein Automotive parts, Pentosin technical fluids, and AJUSA gaskets and head bolts. Beyond new parts, CRP has extensive capabilities in mechanical and electronic remanufacturing, restoring components such as ABS modules, electronic power-steering modules, transmission control modules, instrument clusters, engine control modules, hybrid system inverters, and a range of other mechatronic units. Its product catalog, accessible via an online platform powered by ShowMeTheParts.com, covers nearly every automotive service and repair category for both import and domestic vehicles.

CRP Automotive serves the professional automotive repair market, working closely with technicians who select and install its products in shops across North America. Its customer base includes warehouse distributors, repair shops, and fleet operators seeking OE-quality or upgraded replacement parts. The company also partners with major e-catalog platforms such as Activant/Epicor and WHI to ensure parts data reaches installers efficiently.

CRP states its purpose is to build a sustainable community where people and machines perform at their best, and its vision is to be the service-market partner that creates solutions for problems caused by advancing vehicle technology. The firm emphasizes its deep remanufacturing expertise and direct engagement with repair professionals as key differentiators that keep vehicles on the road longer and stronger.

name: CRS Hoods LLC - Restaurant Hood Installation
old_description: Your restaurant can’t open without a code-compliant hood system. Since 1980, We’ve installed 10,000+ commercial kitchen exhaust systems across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, and Maryland—every one engineered to pass inspection the first time.
about:
CRS Hoods LLC operates from Smyrna, Delaware, tracing its roots to 1980 when Ron Grantland founded AG&G Sheet Metal, Inc. The family-owned business passed to his sons, Geoff and Andy, who worked alongside their father for decades. In 2016 Andy and his wife Samantha launched Grantlin Fabrication, LLC, and in July 2022 the brothers established CRS Hoods LLC to continue the legacy of code-compliant kitchen ventilation.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs complete commercial kitchen ventilation systems. Its services cover Type I and Type II hood installation, exhaust fan installation and emergency repair, make-up air unit installation and balancing, welded grease duct fabrication, fire suppression integration, and ongoing repair, cleaning, and preventive maintenance. CRS Hoods serves Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, and Maryland, with more than 10,000 systems installed since 1980. The team includes a CEO, vice president, and senior supervisor, supported by field technicians who schedule work around kitchen operations, including nights and early mornings.

Customers range from independent restaurants and fast-food chains to cafes, bakeries, bars, hotels, schools, hospitals, food trucks, ghost kitchens, and institutional cafeterias. The company also works on food hall projects and other multi-venue operations.

CRS Hoods emphasizes a "first-time pass" inspection record, built on three pillars: maintaining proper clearance from combustibles per NFPA 96, calculating make-up air to balance building pressure, and ensuring airstream integrity through liquid-tight external welds. It holds professional licenses in all four states it serves and promotes end-to-end service from on-site assessment and CAD-backed design through final inspection walkthrough.

name: CTI Foods Soups Plant
old_description: CTI Foods has been serving the food service industry since 1986. What began as a small business has now flourished into an innovation-focused manufacturing and culinary company. We take pride in our six processing facilities strategically positioned across the United States.
about:
CTI Foods, headquartered in Saginaw, Texas, was founded in 1986 as a small business and has grown into an innovation-focused manufacturing and culinary company with six processing facilities strategically positioned across the United States.

The company specializes in custom food manufacturing, offering flash freezing, specialty packaging, and scale-to-volume production capabilities. Its six facilities provide supply chain redundancy for clients, supported by a team of classically trained chefs and food scientists who collaborate on product development from ideation to commercialization, including sensory science, line automation, and culinary supervision in every plant.

CTI Foods serves the food service industry, including global restaurant chains, distributors, food manufacturers, ingredient customers, and retailers. The company partners with clients to develop custom food products, menu concepts, and gold-standard flavor delivery systems that set brands apart.

The company differentiates itself through a rare combination of culinary expertise, technical innovation, and a commitment to the Global Food Safety Initiative, emphasizing small-kitchen craftsmanship at national scale and an entrepreneurial spirit that drives strategic partnerships with the largest North American customers.

name: CUSTOM CUSTOMS INC.
old_description: With each entrusted client, Nick and the staff, here at Custom Customs Inc, makes sure every aspect of your work and experience is flawless. Using the same system as the coroners office, your job is carefully examined from the beginning of your estimate, to fabrication, to powder coat, and finally installation.
about:
Custom Customs Inc. is based in Henderson, Nevada. Founded in 2018 by Nick Baumert, the company began in his garage with $12 and a dream. Baumert, a former union ironworker and Clark County coroner's office funeral director, started the business as a single father without loans or outside partners.

The shop produces custom metalwork including security doors, pedestrian gates, RV gates, community and commercial entrance gates, CNC-cut décor and monogram signs, and security door inlays. Services also cover 24/7 emergency mobile welding and repair, with all pieces moving through an in-house process of estimation, fabrication, powder coating, and installation.

Customers range from homeowners seeking residential security and decorative ironwork to commercial clients needing community entrance gates and custom fabrication. The company serves the greater Las Vegas area.

Baumert's background in the coroner's office shaped a quality-control system that tracks each job from estimate through final installation, aiming to leave no step missed. The firm emphasizes a customer-first philosophy rooted in the belief that every problem has a solution.

The shop specializes in metal fabrication, producing component parts, assemblies, and complete products. Its capabilities include six-axis laser cutting, nine-axis forming, robotic welding, and multiple flexible manufacturing systems, allowing it to handle a range of project sizes.

name: Cable Conveyor Systems Inc
old_description: Since 1975, Cable Conveyor Systems, Inc. has been manufacturing conveying systems for processors in a wide variety of industries such as the food, dairy, beverage, motor oil, laundry soap, and pet food industries –
about:
Cable Conveyor Systems Inc. was founded in 1975 in Columbia, South Carolina. President David M. Rauscher has been with the company since its inception and leads the business alongside Vice President Brooke Spence.

The company designs, manufactures, and installs custom cable conveyor systems for processors that move cans or plastic containers. Its product line includes cable can tracks, diverter gates, accessories, reconditioning parts, and bulk can cable, all built in aluminum or stainless steel. Cable Conveyor holds several national and international patents for its equipment, notably the Extruda-Mold® cable splicing system. Services span consulting, system design, on-site audits, and a portable splicing service that can be performed at a customer’s plant in about one hour.

Primary markets are food, dairy, beverage, motor oil, laundry soap, and pet food manufacturers—any operation that conveys cans or plastic containers. Customers range from new installations to existing lines needing integration, flow improvements, or production increases.

The firm emphasizes a full-service model: on-site audits deliver a photo‑documented report with a flat fee plus travel, and its patented Extruda-Mold splicing technique is guaranteed for two years on full can lines and four years on empty can lines. The stated mission is to provide excellent customer service through customized solutions.

name: Cable Manufacturing Technologies
old_description: Cable Manufacturing Technologies provides a wide range of cable products to meet the needs of every customer. From initial design to final quality assurance processes, we make sure our goods are reliable and exceptional. We’re proud to be one of the best-known names in the industry. Get in touch to see how you can benefit from our products.
about:
Cable Manufacturing Technologies, operating as CMT Cables, was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Roseville, California. The company was established by partners with combined decades of experience in cable manufacturing across the United States, China, and Taiwan, positioning itself as a global supplier of cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, and stock cable products.

The company designs and manufactures custom cable assemblies and wiring harnesses, with every unit 100% tested to customer specifications. It maintains an inventory of over 20,000 stock cable SKUs in California and operates manufacturing facilities in three regions: a U.S. site capable of low-volume custom assembly and 50,000+ SKU distribution; a China facility offering high-volume production, overmolding, and tooling; and a Taiwan facility providing high-volume manufacturing, box builds, and metal fabrication. Order volumes range from single-piece prototypes to thousands of units.

CMT Cables serves resellers, distributors, and original equipment manufacturers across any industry requiring cable prototypes or production runs. Its product categories span networking, audio/video, computer, fiber optic, security, and industrial connectivity, reflecting a broad customer base that includes electronics, telecommunications, and industrial equipment sectors.

The company emphasizes a partnership model that leverages global manufacturing strengths for cost and delivery advantages, coupled with a stated commitment to personal customer interest. Customization is highlighted as a core specialty, with material recommendations aimed at reducing cost while maintaining quality.
